messages:
marina: T-minus ~90m to midnight change window for the v3.4.0 rollout. Key notes: partner-payments handshake needs the X-Interop-Version header in prod (staging is fine but prod was missing the header). Planned ops: pin api-proxy to v3.4.0 during the window, run online DB migration at 00:30 UTC, and enable the dedicated-pool edge flag. CC @ops_oncall and SRE.

ben: A quick update — patch with header handling was merged to main last night but not active on dedicated pools. I'll flip the dedicated flag once canary is stable.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: start=1716010001 (00:01 UTC), id=c-2024-11-17-0001. Note: pins are applied after canary success. Command examples: ```/deploy pin api-proxy v3.4.0 --scope=release-war-room``` ```/deploy abort c-2024-11-17-0001```

sam: Quick Q — the DB migration at 00:30, is that online? any expected locks?

marina: Migration is online (additive schema + backfill). No exclusive locks expected; backfill runs with chunked batching. SQL snippet for ops: ```ALTER TABLE payments ADD COLUMN interop_version varchar(16) DEFAULT '1'; -- backfill: UPDATE payments SET interop_version='1' WHERE interop_version IS NULL LIMIT 10000;``` Will monitor replication lag.

ops_oncall: I'm on standby at 00:00. Rollback/abort criteria: error rate >1.5x baseline OR p95 latency >600ms sustained for 5m. If triggered: 1) call /deploy abort or unpin, 2) rollback api-proxy to v3.3.7, 3) clear prefix caches and restart proxy pool. My escalation path is Zuri -> oncall lead. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/emergency-unwind

dalia: I will own the unwind ops if needed. Also prepped the cache-clear script: ```/scripts/clear_prefix_cache.sh --prefix=api-proxy-v3.4```. Ensure we have keys to flush dedicated caches (ops_oncall has creds).

ben: Done — enabled edge flag on dedicated pools for the header handler. Rolling a small warmup to 2 hosts now.

deploy-bot: Canary update: started at 1716010001, monitoring hooks active (health, handshake). Link: https://deploys/release/c-2024-11-17-0001. Alerts wired to #incidents and ops_oncall.

marina: Pin list for this change (to be applied post-canary): [api-proxy -> v3.4.0, transformer -> q4-1a-quant, routing -> stable-2026]. If we need emergency-unwind, use `/scripts/emergency_unwind.sh c-2024-11-17-0001` and follow the runbook steps.

ops_oncall: Watching dashboards and partner webhook logs. I'll post a status at each milestone (canary, 20% ramp, full).

deploy-bot: Canary success: 5m steady, error rate <0.2% and handshake tests green. Proceeding to 20% at 1716010600 (00:10 UTC). To abort: `/deploy abort c-2024-11-17-0001`.

marina: Thanks — update here when 20% holds for 10m. :thumbsup:
